decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - Details of external brickwork, pointing, mortar, and bonding shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 1 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects and should be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects and should be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - Further details of the treatment of the floor of the building shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to these works being carried out.

Condition : 7 - The wall coverings, plaster etc shall be carefully stripped to reveal any underlying timber frame that may exist, in addition to that which is already visible. If any further timber framework is found no part shall be cut or removed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority. A sample of the plasterboard metal stud work that would cover these timbers should be submitted for written approval by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
description: Alterations to internal layout and bricking up of some windows and doors, incorporating works to garden
